items.title: John Casimir Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: I played Chris Keller band, all the oil up and all the trombones.

ctx.x: Joe Watkins, he was very glad he was. Did you work at Chris's funeral when he died? Hmm? Did you work at Chris's funeral when he died? I'm not afraid at Chris's funeral. Did you work at René's funeral?

Right? And then I'll be there when I'm with Chris Keller. I don't know. I didn't play that cue. He died downtown. I played Chris Keller band, all the oil up and all the trombones. Poor's his brother, oil up and all the trombones. Poor's his brother, oil up and all the trombones. He was away from me. The weather played Clyde, see? Poor's a great trouble. Poor's a great trombone. Yeah. I ran up with him. He was a great team. Mm-hmm.

Now, who would Chris play for? What kind of people? Hmm? What kind of places would Chris play in? Who would he play for? Who would he play for? Oh, he'd go to Santa Sons and Copper Riven Hall and E. Codd Hall. He'd go to high and more around. He'd go to high and more. Was Chris a flashy dresser or did he dress for playing?
